jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Mercari / Crossborder
jobs.description:
本ポジションは日本語JDの用意がありません。

Senior Product Designer - Mercari / Crossborder

  • Employment Status:　Full-time 
  • Work Hours: Full Flextime (no core time)  
  • Office: Roppongi

For more details, see the Overview of Our Positions section on our Careers site.


About Mercari

Circulate all forms of value to unleash the potential in all people

"What can I do to help society thrive with the finite resources we have?" The Mercari marketplace app was born in 2013 out of this thought by our founder Shintaro Yamada as he traveled the world. We believe that by circulating all forms of value, not just physical things and money, we can create opportunities for anyone to realize their dreams and contribute to society and the people around them. Mercari aims to use technology to connect people all over the world and create a world where anyone can unleash their potential. For more information about Mercari Group’s mission, see Mercari’s Culture Doc


　
Organization/Team Mission

Mercari has been operating marketplaces localized in two countries, Japan and the United States, and the Crossborder team recently released a new global app , already in use in Hong-kong and Taiwan that we aim to deploy  in over 100 countries. For requests from each region, it must be developed with a global perspective, including standardization and consolidation to avoid excessive localization.

The integration of Crossborder e-commerce and local business is heavily reliant on a robust logistics network and efficient operations. This necessitates working closely with numerous third-party vendors. Through this experience, you will acquire a wide range of business knowledge and apply it to engineering, collaborating closely with teams such as product and operations.

Trade-offs will have to be made to build a strong foundation while assuring a reasonable time to market. The team must balance short-term initiatives and the long term goal for the Global Product. Constructive discussions that transcend individual job roles, whether you are an engineer or a Business Developer, are essential for moving forward effectively.

The New Business Design Team leads end-to-end user experience design for emerging product initiatives at Mercari, shaping intuitive, trustworthy, and high-quality experiences for domestic and international users. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Business Development to explore new problem spaces and raise the bar for craft, consistency, and innovation.

See here for more information about our mission and values.


　
Why this role matters 

This role plays a critical part in shaping how buyers experience Mercari at scale. As the marketplace evolves, we’re entering new problem spaces where clarity, trust, and experience quality matter more than ever. Senior Designers in this role don’t just execute solutions — they help define the problems worth solving and set the bar for what “good” looks like.

You’ll be trusted to operate with a high degree of ownership, leading end-to-end experiences in ambiguous areas while balancing user needs, business goals, and long-term product quality. Your work will directly influence how buyers discover value, make confident decisions, and build trust with the marketplace.

This role matters because strong design leadership here creates leverage: it unlocks better collaboration, sharper product thinking, and more durable experiences that scale beyond a single feature or release. We’re looking for designers who care deeply about craft, can think beyond the immediate task, and want to shape the future of the buyer experience internationally.



Work Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end design for buyer-facing experiences, from discovery and problem framing through execution and launch.
  • Act as Lead Designer for assigned product areas, setting experience direction and design quality standards.
  • Translate ambiguous business and user problems into clear experience strategies, flows, and high-quality UI.
  • Drive design decisions through strong craft, systems thinking, and user-centered rationale.
  • Collaborate deeply with PM, Eng, and UXR to shape product direction and influence roadmaps.
  • Identify gaps and opportunities beyond the immediate scope and proactively propose new ideas, concepts, or improvements.
  • Contribute to and evolve shared design systems, patterns, and best practices.
  • Provide thoughtful feedback and mentorship to other designers, raising the overall quality of work.


　
Unique Challenges

  • Designing for large-scale, real-world marketplace complexity with diverse buyer needs and behaviors.
  • Leading design in unexplored or undisclosed product areas with high ambiguity and few precedents.
  • Balancing speed, experimentation, and innovation with a high bar for craft, trust, and usability.
  • Navigating cross-team and cross-function alignment while maintaining clear experience ownership.
  • Designing for the Japanese market with strong attention to cultural nuance, trust, and clarity.



Qualifications

  • Required Experience/Skills
    • 6+ years of experience in product, UX, or interaction design with ownership of end-to-end experiences.
    • Strong craft skills across UX, interaction design, and visual design, with a sharp eye for detail and quality.
    • Proven ability to lead design for complex or ambiguous problem spaces.
    • Experience influencing product direction through design thinking, concepts, and storytelling.
    • Solid understanding of design systems, scalable patterns, and consistency at scale.
    • Strong collaboration and communication skills with cross-functional partners.
    • A portfolio demonstrating high-quality shipped work, problem-solving depth, and design leadership.

  • Preferred Experience/Skills
    • Experience designing marketplace, e-commerce, or transaction-based products.
    • Experience acting as a lead designer across multiple teams or initiatives.
    • Familiarity with user research methods and applying insights to design decisions.
    • Experience working in or designing for the Japanese market.
    • Comfort experimenting, prototyping, and iterating quickly in uncertain environments.
    • Conversational Japanese proficiency

  • Language 
    • English: Proficient (CEFR – C1)
    • Japanese: Basic (CEFR – A2)

For details about CEFR, see here.
　

　
Learn More About Mercari Group

  • Careers site: https://careers.mercari.com/en/   
  • Mercan: https://mercan.mercari.com/en/  
  • Social media: X / Linkedin 



Recruiting at Mercari

At Mercari Group, we value empathizing with and embodying the mission and values ​​of the Group and each company. To promote the creation of an organization that maximizes the total amount of value exhibited by all members, we would like to understand the experience and skills of each candidate as accurately as possible.

Recruiting cycle at Mercari Group

  • Application screening
  • Skill assessment: For engineering positions, you will be asked to complete a skill assessment on HackerRank or GitHub. For non-engineering positions, you may be asked to complete an assessment depending on the position. (The timing of the assessment may coincide with the interview process.)
  • Interview: The number of interviews may vary depending on the position.
  • Reference check: We will ask for online references around the timing of the final interview.
  • Offer: Offers will be determined carefully in consideration of the final interview and the reference check.

　Learn more about our recruiting process here.


　
Equal Opportunity Hiring

Here at Mercari, we work to realize a world in which no one’s potential is limited by their background and everyone has the opportunity to freely create value. We also firmly believe that a mindset of Inclusion & Diversity is essential for us to achieve our mission.

This, of course, extends to our hiring practices as well. Mercari is committed to eliminating discrimination based on age, gender, sexual orientation, race, religion, physical disability, and other such factors so that anyone who shares our mission and values can join us, regardless of their background. For more details, please read our I&D statement.

Please read and acknowledge our Privacy Policy prior to submitting your application.

🪐 Discover our galaxy
 
Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐


Explore your future career  🔭
As the Head of Product Design at Malt, you will lead a high-impact segment of our design organization, acting as a strategic partner in shaping how freelancers and clients connect, transact, and collaborate globally.
Your mission is to elevate Malt’s core product experience by connecting exceptional user experiences directly to commercial growth. Under your leadership, your initiatives will drive demonstrable lifts in core user health metrics, conversion funnels, and key commercial KPIs. You will ensure the product design function is staffed with top talent, fostering a culture of strong psychological safety and maintaining a high craft quality bar.
Reporting to Stefanie Fleisch (VP of Design), you will take a holistic view of our primary product domains. Your goal is to break down feature silos across multi-squad streams, delivering cohesive user journeys that are intuitive, clean, and built to scale.

AT COVERON, WE’RE BUILDING A COMPLETE IDENTITY THEFT PROTECTION SERVICE.

Join the team behind Nord Security’s latest product—combining dark web monitoring, credit tracking, and identity theft insurance into one powerful platform.

Your impact? Helping people protect their identities, spot threats early, and recover stronger.

Main Responsibilities

 - Lead and mentor a team of Product Designers fostering a collaborative and creative work environment.

 - Act as a hands-on designer, spending the majority of your time creating wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, leading by example and setting the quality bar through your own work.

 - Collaborate closely with the Product and Engineering teams to drive design initiatives.

 - Drive the overall design strategy and vision for the design team, aligning it with business objectives and Coveron brand guidelines.

 - Oversee the end-to-end design process, from concept to implementation, ensuring a user-centric approach and a seamless cross-platform user experience.

 - Conduct regular design reviews, providing constructive feedback to the team to elevate the overall design quality.

 - Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and design best practices to continuously improve Coveron design standards.

 - Work closely with stakeholders to understand business goals and user needs, translating them into actionable design strategies.

 - Combine strong people management and leadership skills with a solid design background to foster a positive and collaborative team culture.



CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of experience in product design, with at least 2 years in a leadership role in a product-focused environment.

 - Strong portfolio showcasing a range of successful design projects with a focus on app design.

 - Expertise in app design, with knowledge of best practices for iOS, Android, and web platforms.

 - Excellent leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

 - Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to bridge the gap between design and development.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description:
THE ROLE 

We’re looking for a Product Designer to shape digital in-vehicle experiences for our development and demonstration fleet. Your work will span tools used by trained vehicle operators during testing and validation, alongside guest-facing interfaces that help a wide range of people understand and experience Wayve’s enriched ADAS and automated-driving technology.

You’ll help us explore new ways for people to understand and interact with autonomous driving technology. You’ll own defined product features from discovery through to delivery, combining user insight, interaction design and strong visual design. You’ll think beyond the screen, considering how visual interfaces, sound, haptics and lighting can work together to make complex technology clear, intuitive and accessible.

You’ll work within a supportive, experienced design environment, partnering closely with Product, Engineering and Operations.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Conduct research, observation and usability testing with operators, guests and customers

 - Turn user needs, complex technology and operational requirements into clear journeys, workflows and interactions

 - Apply inclusive and accessible design principles, considering a broad range of needs, abilities and contexts of use

 - Design interactions across visual interfaces, sound, haptics and lighting, considering how they work together as one experience

 - Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes and polished production-ready designs

 - Define interaction states, edge cases and feedback in sufficient detail for implementation

 - Collaborate with stakeholders to balance user needs, product goals and technical constraints

 - Review implementation, resolve design issues and help maintain a high quality bar in the finished experience

 - Contribute reusable interaction and visual patterns across Wayve’s vehicle-related products

 


ABOUT YOU  

For this role, we’re looking for the following skills and experience.


ESSENTIAL

 - A portfolio demonstrating strong interaction and visual/UI craft, including the ability to make complex information and interactions clear without losing important detail

 - An understanding of inclusive and accessible design, and how different needs and contexts can shape an experience

 - Strong wireframing and prototyping skills, with the ability to choose the right level of fidelity for the problem

 - Curiosity and sound judgement: you’re comfortable questioning assumptions, exploring different approaches and working through ambiguity and constraints

 - Clear communication and the ability to explain the thinking behind your design decisions

 - Experience owning product problems through discovery, design, validation and delivery

 - Experience planning and conducting user research or usability testing and applying what you learn

 - Experience collaborating closely with product managers and engineers throughout product development


DESIRABLE

 - Experience designing interfaces that connect people with complex, real-time or physical systems. This could come from automotive or mobility, but equally from areas such as gaming, robotics, industrial products, kiosks or other interactive machines

 - Experience working with constrained environments, where factors such as hardware, safety, attention or context place limits on interaction design

 - Experience designing operational tools, real-time interfaces or products used by people with widely differing levels of technical knowledge

 - Experience using generative AI and coding tools to explore ideas, build prototypes or contribute directly to implementation

 - Automotive experience, such as designing in-vehicle interfaces, working with Android Auto or understanding market-specific guidance such as JAMA, is useful but not required

As part of the interview process, we’ll ask you to provide examples of your work that demonstrate strong interaction and visual design across digital products or interactive experiences.

This is a full-time role based in our office in London, UK. At Wayve we want the best of all worlds so we operate a hybrid working policy that combines time together in our offices and workshops to fuel innovation, culture, relationships and learning, and time spent working from home.

jobs.title: Senior Product Design Manager, Enterprise
Lead Product Designer
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

The Opportunity

As a Lead Product Designer at Motorway, you won't just be producing great design - you'll be raising the ceiling for everyone around you. You'll shape how the team works, set the standard for craft and rigour, and bring a clear point of view on where design is heading.

You'll take ownership of our most complex design challenges, working across the full product lifecycle from discovery to delivery. You'll be a trusted voice in cross-functional conversations, a mentor to other designers, and someone who actively shapes the culture and ways of working within the design team.

This is a role for someone who thinks deeply, builds boldly, and leads by doing.

What You'll Be Doing

This isn't a role for a pixel-pusher. We want a visionary with a builder’s soul. You will step into an environment where your work has immediate, massive scale, and your leadership directly influences the future of our product ecosystem.

 - Tackling the Big Stuff: You’ll own our most complex, ambiguous product challenges, transforming messy problems into elegant, crystal-clear user experiences from discovery to deployment.

 - Pioneering AI in Design: You won't just use AI tools—you’ll write the playbook for them. You'll spearhead how our team thoughtfully integrates AI to supercharge our workflows while keeping human judgment and craft at the center.

 - Designing Beyond the Screen: You'll bring a "builder mindset" to the table, collaborating seamlessly with engineering because you speak their language—whether that’s through code, complex prototypes, or building your own tools.

 - Championing the User: You will be the fierce advocate for our users, leveraging deep research, continuous usability testing, and sharp data insights to validate every move we make.

 - Scaling Design Culture: You'll run high-impact workshops, level up weekly team rituals, and foster an environment where diverse perspectives thrive and designers do the best work of their careers.

Responsibilities

 - Design Execution: Produce high-quality design deliverables including user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity mock-ups for mobile and web applications, ensuring solutions meet accessibility standards and set the bar for inclusive design across the team.

 - Collaboration & Commercial Awareness: Work in close partnership with product managers, engineers, and data analysts throughout the product development lifecycle. Connect user insights to product opportunities and broader business goals. You have strong commercial awareness and can articulate the business case for design decisions.

 - Stakeholder Communication: Establish strong relationships across product, engineering, and the wider organisation. Communicate clearly at all levels, lead online and offline sessions to validate design decisions, and represent product design with confidence and authority.

 - Mentorship & Guidance: Provide mentorship to junior and senior designers alike - sharing best practices, supporting their growth, and helping create an environment where designers can do the best work of their careers.

 - Driving Design Culture: Help foster a strong design culture by contributing to weekly team rituals, running workshops, planning design-focused events, and encouraging diverse participation. You love bringing people together around ideas.

 - Continuous Improvement: Explore and encourage continuous learning across the team, playing an active role in developing our core design principles and keeping the team sharp on emerging tools, patterns, and practices.

What You'll Bring (Requirements)

Our team comes from a diverse range of backgrounds, and team fit matters immensely to us. We are looking for a passionate advocate for craft and user experience who can check off several of these boxes:

 - Proven Leadership: A deep track record as a Senior or Lead Product Designer, successfully shipping impactful digital products across web and mobile ecosystems.

 - A Builder’s Instinct: You don’t stop at the design file. You love getting your hands dirty and have experience shipping code, building your own products, or spinning up functional, high-fidelity tools and prototypes.

 - Versatile Experience: A strong grasp of consumer journeys, ideally with experience navigating both B2C and B2B product landscapes.

 - An AI-Forward Mindset: A highly considered approach to AI in design. You understand how to strategically use it to accelerate work, when to rely on human judgment, and how to guide a team through this evolving landscape.

 - Commercial Acumen: The ability to see the bigger picture, connect design execution directly to business outcomes, and confidently shape broader product strategy.

 - Modern Toolkit & Research Rigour: High proficiency in design and prototyping tools (like Figma, Claude, Kiro), combined with strong user-centered design methodologies, accessibility standards, and research synthesisation.

 - Bonus Points: Experience optimizing user journeys/conversion funnels via experimentation, or experience working within a fast-paced, two-sided marketplace.

BENEFITS

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

 - Competitive salary

 - Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway's success

 - 25 days holiday

 - Flexible working (2 days a week in our London office, with socials and snacks galore)

 - Private medical insurance via BUPA

 - Life assurance

 - Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

 - Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

 - 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

 - EV leasing scheme

 - Cycle to work scheme

 - Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

 - 1 paid volunteering day a year

jobs.description: <p>關於團隊<br>FinTech UX 團隊負責打造 Coupang 生態系中的直覺化、值得信賴且具可擴展性的金融服務體驗。我們的使命是透過建立卓越的支付體驗，幫助顧客輕鬆且安心地完成付款，進一步消除電商流程中的各種摩擦與障礙。<br>作為台灣支付（Taiwan Payments）團隊的資深產品設計師（Staff Product Designer），您將負責規劃並推動關鍵支付體驗的設計策略與執行，涵蓋整個顧客旅程。您將與產品管理、工程、資料科學、商務、營運、風險管理、法務合規及行銷團隊密切合作，共同定義台灣支付服務的未來藍圖。<br>這是一個高度策略性的個人貢獻者（Individual Contributor, IC）職位，適合能夠親自參與設計工作、善於面對不確定性、影響產品發展方向，並創造實質商業與客戶價值的設計領導者。<br><br><br>【工作內容】<br><br>• 主導台灣支付產品與體驗的端到端設計流程，從策略制定、設計執行到後續優化。<br>• 定義使用者體驗（UX）願景，影響產品策略，並規劃支付體驗發展藍圖（Roadmap）。<br>• 設計流暢且值得信賴的支付旅程，涵蓋結帳流程（Checkout）、電子錢包（Wallet）、身份驗證（Authentication）及未來金融科技產品。<br>• 領導具高度不確定性的 0→1 創新專案，打造全新的支付體驗，創造客戶與商業價值。<br>• 將使用者洞察、商業目標、技術限制及法規要求轉化為直覺且易用的產品體驗。<br>• 透過使用者研究、數據分析、產品實驗及市場洞察，發掘機會並推動可衡量的商業成果。<br>• 定義成功指標，持續改善轉換率（Conversion）、支付成功率、產品採用率及顧客信任度。<br>• 建立可擴展的設計框架、設計模式（Design Patterns）及支付體驗相關 UX 標準。<br>• 與產品、工程、資料科學、風險管理、法務、合規及商業團隊緊密合作，交付高品質解決方案，並影響組織層級決策。<br>&nbsp;<br><br>【條件要求】<br>&nbsp;<br>• 平面設計、互動設計、工業設計、人機互動（HCI）、資訊工程、心理學或相關科系學位，或具同等工作經驗。<br>• 8年以上產品設計（Product Design）、使用者體驗設計（UX Design）或相關領域工作經驗。<br>• 具備設計並成功推出面向消費者數位產品的實務經驗。<br>• 擁有優秀作品集，能展現策略思維、UX問題解決能力、互動設計、視覺設計能力及可衡量的商業成果。<br>• 曾主導複雜、高度模糊且跨部門合作的專案，從概念發想到正式上線。<br>• 精通以使用者為中心（User-Centered Design）的設計方法與完整產品設計流程。<br>• 熟練使用 Figma 及現代設計工具。<br>• 能透過簡報、敘事能力（Storytelling）及數據清楚表達設計理念與決策依據。<br>• 具備與產品管理及工程團隊密切合作的經驗。<br>• 具備優秀的跨部門協作與利害關係人管理能力。<br>• 具備流利中文及英文溝通能力。<br><br>&nbsp;<br>【加分條件】<br><br>• 具備支付（Payments）、金融科技（FinTech）、銀行、電子錢包、貸款、信用卡或金融服務產品設計經驗。<br>• 曾參與台灣或其他亞太地區（APAC）市場產品設計工作。<br>• 深入了解支付生態系統、風險控管、身份驗證、防詐騙機制及相關法規要求。<br>• 具備運用使用者研究與數據分析推動產品策略制定的經驗。<br>• 曾在高速成長且大規模運作的組織環境中工作。<br>• 具備電子商務（E-commerce）、平台市集（Marketplace）或大型消費者產品平台相關經驗。<br>• 曾成功影響高階主管決策並推動組織共識建立。<br>• 能夠整合質化與量化研究成果，轉化為具體可執行的產品與設計決策。</p>

jobs.title: iGaming UI/UX Designer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote
URL: https://ondeckglobal.com/

About the Role

We are looking for a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer with a strong understanding of the iGaming industry to create engaging, intuitive, and visually compelling digital experiences.
You will be responsible for designing user-focused interfaces across online casino, sportsbook, betting, and gaming platforms, working closely with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to transform product requirements into seamless player experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong visual design skills with UX thinking and understands how to design interfaces that are engaging, responsive, conversion-focused, and easy to navigate.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design modern, high-quality UI/UX for iGaming websites, web apps, and mobile experiences.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity interfaces in Figma.
  • Design key iGaming experiences such as casino lobbies, sportsbook interfaces, game discovery, promotions, tournaments, loyalty/VIP areas, registration, deposits, and withdrawals.
  • Improve player journeys with a focus on usability, engagement, retention, and conversion.
  • Build and maintain scalable design systems, UI components, typography, iconography, and reusable design patterns.
  • Create responsive designs that deliver a consistent experience across desktop, tablet, and mobile.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Development, Marketing, CRM, and other teams from concept through implementation.
  • Work with developers to ensure accurate implementation and maintain high visual quality.
  • Use research, analytics, user feedback, and product insights to identify UX improvements.
  • Continuously improve existing interfaces through iteration, testing, and optimization.
  • Stay current with iGaming design trends, competitor products, UX best practices, and emerging technologies.
  • Design with accessibility, responsible gaming principles, and market-specific requirements in mind.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of UI/UX or Product Design experience, preferably within iGaming, gaming, fintech, entertainment, or another fast-paced digital product environment.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating polished UI design and thoughtful UX problem-solving.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma, including components, variants, Auto Layout, prototyping, and design systems.
  • Strong understanding of responsive and mobile-first design.
  • Excellent knowledge of typography, spacing, grids, color, hierarchy, and interaction design.
  • Experience translating complex product requirements into simple, intuitive user experiences.
  • Good understanding of user journeys, conversion funnels, and usability principles.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with developers and understand technical constraints.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain consistency across large products.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-moving environment.

iGaming Experience — Strong Advantage

Experience designing any of the following will be highly valued:

  • Online Casino & Live Casino
  • Sportsbook & Sports Betting
  • Slots and Game Lobbies
  • Registration & KYC flows
  • Deposits, Withdrawals & Payment UX
  • Bonuses & Promotions
  • VIP & Loyalty Programs
  • Tournaments & Gamification
  • Player Account & Wallet Experiences
  • CRM and Retention Experiences
  • Multi-brand or White-label Gaming Platforms

Nice to Have

  • Experience with A/B testing and conversion optimization.
  • Understanding of HTML/CSS and front-end development principles.
  • Experience working with analytics and behavioral tools.
  • Experience designing gamification and reward mechanics.
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.
  • Experience working with international or multi-market products.
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards and responsible gaming UX.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for more than someone who can make screens look good.
You should be able to understand player behavior, business objectives, and product requirements, then turn them into experiences that are intuitive, engaging, and commercially effective.
You care about the details, challenge weak UX, communicate your design decisions clearly, and enjoy building digital products that players genuinely enjoy using.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/ondeckglobal-igaming-ui-ux-designer
